on(dragOver,rollOver){
   _root.actiondescription = "Offline Progress allows you to progress even when you aren't playing!

If Offline Progress is enabled, the following things will happen when you aren't playing:
- You will gain some EXP and Coins.
- You will be able to REST, allowing you to gain EXP and Coins more quickly, and gain special bonuses in other features.
- Progress Box Fragments will be consumed to create Progress Boxes.
- Your Energy in Awesome Adventures will be recovered.
- Your Fatigue in Fishing will decrease.
- Garden trees will grow and expire.
- Time-limited Battle Arena items will expire.
- Your Pet will get hungry and lose Fullness / Health.
- 50% of offline time will count towards your play time.";
}
